requires: no other GB10 benchmark or sb-gb10-* / aiso_platform_gb10_* container
at least 60 GB MemAvailable (other services stopped by the operator)
model in the HF cache dir (offline)
NP x (input + output) above the KV cache vLLM reports is still sent (vLLM queues / preempts); the line carries '(KV tight: need > kv tokens)'
progress_lines: vllm/<model> NP=<n> input=<i> R=<r> PASS|FAIL agg=<tok/s> ttft_ms=<ms> tpot_ms=<ms>
params_adjustable: np 1-5, input 128-131072, output 16-1024; standard: up to 4 inputs and 4 NPs, repeats 1-3
